messages.subject: Letter of Claim - Brampton Leisure Ltd / Hartwell Construction Ltd - The Vault Birmingham
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Sirs,

We act for Brampton Leisure Limited. Please find attached our Letter of Claim under the Pre-Action Protocol for Construction and Engineering Disputes in relation to defective works at The Vault Birmingham. We look forward to your acknowledgement within 14 days and your full Letter of Response within 28 days thereafter.

Yours faithfully,
Whitfield Carter LLP

Dear Sirs,

We acknowledge receipt of your Letter of Claim dated 14 November 2024 and confirm that we act for Hartwell Construction Ltd. We will provide our client's full Letter of Response within the protocol period. Liability is not admitted.

Yours faithfully,
Olivia Marsh
Drummond Hale LLP
